description: This file defines a custom ScrollView class for Android that allows enabling or disabling scrolling functionality based on a flag.

classes.name: CustomScrollView
classes.description: A subclass of ScrollView that provides an option to enable or disable user scrolling.

methods.name: setEnableScrolling
methods.description: Enables or disables scrolling based on the input parameter.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Determines if touch events should be intercepted based on the scrolling enable flag.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events according to whether scrolling is enabled or not.
